recent.title: Airworthiness Directives; Bombardier, Inc., Airplanes
recent.abstract: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain Bombardier, Inc., Model BD-700-2A12 airplanes. recent.title: Airworthiness Directives; Leonardo S.p.a. Helicopters
recent.abstract: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for all Leonardo S.p.a. Model AW189 helicopters. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

recent.abstract: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain Bombardier, Inc. Model BD-700-1A10, and BD-700-1A11 airplanes.
